boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten reservable Davis Family Library group-study rooms, each documented by Middlebury Libraries with a defined capacity and collaboration setup.

cards.title: LIB 150A
cards.subtitle: Davis Family Library · four-person group study room
cards.notes: Reserve this room before meeting; connect laptops to its 22-inch LCD display and use the VGA switch to move between collaborators’ screens.
cards.short_summary: A reservable four-person room with shared-display tools.
cards.evidence_claim: Middlebury Libraries lists LIB 150A as a four-person group study room with a 22-inch LCD display and multi-port VGA switch.
